entries.title: Psalms 126:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of Ascents.>> When the LORD brought back the captivity of Zion, We were like those who dream.

entries.title: Psalms 126:2
segments: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, And our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, "The LORD has done great things for them."

entries.title: Psalms 126:3
segments: The LORD has done great things for us, [And] we are glad.

entries.title: Psalms 126:4
segments: ¶Bring back our captivity, O LORD, As the streams in the South.

entries.title: Psalms 126:5
segments: Those who sow in tears Shall reap in joy.

entries.title: Psalms 126:6
segments: He who continually goes forth weeping, Bearing seed for sowing, Shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, Bringing his sheaves [with him].
